headline: Kshitij Polyline Limited: Rights Issue – Board Approves Revision and Revised Letter of Offer
sum: Kshitij Polyline's board approved a revision to its rights issue and issued a revised letter of offer and corrigendum on 20 August 2026, signaling material changes to the offer terms or structure previously announced.
implication: A mid-course revision to a rights offer typically reflects market feedback, regulatory direction, or shareholder constituency concerns; counsel should verify the grounds for revision (pricing, size, allocation) against SEBI disclosure norms and the original prospectus.
detail: On 20 August 2026, the board of directors of Kshitij Polyline Limited convened and approved a revision to an ongoing rights issue. This was accompanied by issuance of a revised Letter of Offer and a corrigendum to shareholders and the stock exchange. The specific terms of the revision-whether to issue size, price, subscription period, or allocation-are not disclosed in this board minute extract. The company informed the National Stock Exchange (NSE) of the decision via regulatory filing.
